The bass thundered through the private VIP section of "Astral Aquatica," Valerio's flagship club where the real money changed hands. Smoke hung in the air, mingling with the scent of expensive cologne and desperation as businessmen and crime lords alike shouted over the music, their attention split between smartphones and the dancers. Valerio's scaled tail flicked irritably behind him as he lounged in his reserved booth, yellow eyes fixed not on the current performer—a deer demi-human with impressive antlers and even more impressive flexibility—but on the unwitting figure he'd dragged along tonight. He'd dressed them in something inappropriately provocative, the outfit highlighting their skin and hair that was becoming his trademark aesthetic for them in his mind. Three fucking months he'd been stuck playing guardian, and tonight was when his investment would start paying dividends.

"See that?" Valerio leaned close, one arm sliding around their shoulders as he gestured toward the main stage with his free hand, scales glinting under the club's red lighting. His other hand clutched his phone, thumb scrolling through profit projections even as he spoke. "That's fifteen hundred a night, easy. But you—" his finger tapped under their chin, "—you could pull double. Triple, even." His voice carried that particular timbre, that practiced mix of business calculation and false warmth that had lured countless performers into his stable. "These rich fucks go crazy for real talent like you. Exotic, they call it." He sneered the word, yellow eyes flicking toward a group of demi-human executives throwing money at the stage. "Bunch of self-hating pervs with their fetishes."

The director—a wiry coyote demi with expensive glasses and a permanent sneer—approached their booth with a tablet in hand, bowing slightly to Valerio. "Mr. Valenti, we're ready when you are. Studio Three is prepped for the 'First Timer' series." Valerio's mouth forming the shape of delight while his eyes measured value

"Just a little screen test," he purred, showing them the sanitized preview cut rather than the brutal reality of what happened after cameras started rolling. "Nothing crazy. Just dance a little, talk to the camera. If you're good—" his hand tightened on their shoulder, scales rough against skin, "—we move you right up to featured performer. Better than living off my charity, isn't it? Better than ending up like your mother."

Seeing the hesitation, Valerio reached into his suit jacket and pulled out an elegant silver pen—his designer Vex vaporizer that contained a diluted version of his own venom. The club lights caught the metal as he twirled it between his fingers with practiced showmanship. "Every star needs a little help their first time," he said, voice sank to a secretive purr as he leaned closer. "This is premium grade, not the watered-down shit we sell to the normies. Direct from the source." He tapped his own neck where scales met skin, where specialized glands produced the neurotoxin he'd refined into the city's most addictive substance. "One hit and you'll feel like you own the fucking world. No fear, no shame. No more worrying what those cunts think of you, no more crying over mommy dearest abandoning your ass." Valerio's scaled fingers caressed the silver pen with disturbing intimacy, his business smile sharpening as he extended it toward them. The club lights caught in the droplet of condensation forming at the pen's tip – pure, undiluted Vex waiting to transform their nervous system. "Just a little taste of what made your mother a fucking star before she burned out. Don't you wanna know what it feels like? What drove her crazy enough to leave everything behind?"
